title: 第13章 你知道的太多了第14章 灵根特殊可为杂役
slug: 太古神墟第1974章药园小酌
content_zh:
小姑娘还在机械地挥动石头，一下又一下砸向匪徒的脑袋。
“别砸了，脑袋都扁了，死透透的了。
人不大，胆子还不小。”
落尘说着，轻轻拉了一下小姑娘。
“小哥哥，谢谢你救了我，还让我报了仇。
我叫楚如玉，以后就跟着你，当牛做马也愿意。”
小姑娘突然跪在落尘面前。
“不行，不行，别跟着我，我也是小孩呢。”
落尘赶忙拒绝，伸手去扶楚如玉。
“我的亲人都没有了……我十岁了，可以做饭，还可以干很多活。
小哥哥不答应，我就不起来。”
楚如玉很倔强。
跪在地上就是不肯起来。
拉拉扯扯中，落尘裹在腰间的破衣服突然掉了。
刚才的衣服被烧了，他随便找了件匪徒的衣服裹在身上，没系牢实。
楚如玉脸红了，把头扭向一边。
落尘赶紧捡起衣服裹上，尴尬得恨不得找个地缝钻进去。
李富贵帮着处理完孩子的事，回到落尘身边。
“落尘，咱们怎么办？我……”
他的话还没说完，大胡子一瘸一拐回来了：

“小仙人，找到了，找到了。
这个是储物戒指，这个是乾坤袋。”
大胡子一脸媚态。
“怎么用？”
落尘拿着戒指和乾坤袋看来看去。
“我也没有用过，听说用灵气或者是神识打开，要抹掉原主人的禁制的，然后滴血认主……”
大胡子赶紧回答。
“哦，你知道的太多了。”
落尘说着向李富贵递了一个眼色。
李富贵没有丝毫犹豫，手中的腰刀砍下，大胡子“啊”
的一声，人头落地。
斩草必须除根，大胡子绝对不能放了。
同时，这也是对李富贵的考验。
“富贵，我还想去凌霄宗。
你呢？”
“我也去，我必须变强！”
“好，咱们明天一早出发。
content_en:
The little girl was still swinging the stone mechanically, hitting the gangster's head again and again.
"Stop smashing it, your head is flattened and you're completely dead.
He is not big, but he is not timid. "
Luochen said, gently pulling the little girl.
"Little brother, thank you for saving me and allowing me to take revenge.
My name is Chu Ruyu, and I will follow you from now on. I am willing to be a cow or a horse. "
The little girl suddenly knelt down in front of Luochen.
"No, no, don't follow me, I'm a child too."
Luochen quickly refused and reached out to help Chu Ruyu.
“All my relatives are gone…I am ten years old, I can cook and do a lot of work.
If my little brother doesn’t agree, I won’t get up. "
Chu Ruyu is very stubborn.
He was kneeling on the ground but refused to get up.
While pulling and pulling, the tattered clothes wrapped around Luochen's waist suddenly fell off.
The clothes he just wore were burned, so he randomly found a gangster's clothes and wrapped them around him, but didn't tie them tightly.
Chu Ruyu blushed and turned her head to one side.
Luochen quickly picked up his clothes and wrapped them up. He was so embarrassed that he wanted to find a crack in the ground and crawl into it.
Li Fugui helped deal with the child's affairs and returned to Luochen.
"Luochen, what should we do? I..."
Before he finished speaking, the bearded man limped back:
"Little fairy, I found it, I found it.
This is a storage ring, and this is a Qiankun bag. "
The bearded man looked charming.
"How to use it?"
Luochen looked around with the ring and the Qiankun bag.
"I've never used it before. I heard that it can be opened with spiritual energy or spiritual consciousness to erase the original owner's restrictions, and then recognize the owner with a drop of blood..."
The bearded man answered quickly.
"Oh, you know so much."
Luochen said and glanced at Li Fugui.
Li Fugui didn't hesitate at all. He cut off the waist knife in his hand and said "Ah" with a big beard.
With a sound, the head fell to the ground.
The root must be removed to cut the grass, and the beard must not be left alone.
At the same time, this is also a test for Li Fugui.
“Fugui, I still want to go to Lingxiao Sect.
What about you? "
"I'm going too, I have to become stronger!"
"Okay, let's leave early tomorrow morning.
